   [1.34.1] MaestroDriverStartupException$IOSDriverTimeoutException   #1585 New issue Copy link New issue Copy link Closed Bug Closed [1.34.1] MaestroDriverStartupException$IOSDriverTimeoutException #1585 Bug Copy link Labels maestro cli Related to the command-line Maestro tool Related to the command-line Maestro tool platform: ios Testing iOS apps is affected Testing iOS apps is affected waiting for customer response More information is needed from the customer before we can progress on the issue More information is needed from the customer before we can progress on the issue Description nicolas-acl opened  on Nov 10, 2023 Issue body actions Describe the bug 
The issue occurs when running a Flow. 
 To Reproduce 
Steps to reproduce the behavior : 
 
 Start the simulator 
 Run  maestro test ./flows  // (flows is a folder with all my .yml) 
 The Flow fails at Maestro iOS driver did not start up in time. 
 
 Expected behavior 
The error is not occurs

It went away when I increased the driver's timeout from 15s to 60s. The following is from the Maestro docs on how to do this:  https://maestro.mobile.dev/advanced/configuring-maestro-driver-timeout 
 export MAESTRO_DRIVER_STARTUP_TIMEOUT=60000 # setting 60 seconds
